desk.headline: Adjusted EPS $1.91 beat estimates; net sales $6.6bn, below; debt cut to $10.0bn; no new guidance in release

other.label: Free cash flow before working capital

results: Adjusted EPS rose to $1.91 from $0.51 a year ago as higher oil prices lifted earnings; reported EPS was $1.61, cut by derivative losses.
Net sales grew 19% to $6.6bn; realized oil averaged $85.91 a barrel, up from $64.78 a year ago but down 11% from Q2.
Output of 1,427 Mboe/d beat the middle of guidance, as Permian and Rockies offset a pipeline-related curtailment in the Gulf of America.
Free cash flow before working capital was $2.8bn on capital spending of $1.3bn.
Principal debt fell by $1.8bn in the quarter to $10.0bn, a $10.4bn reduction since January; the dividend declared rose to $0.28 a share.

guidance.summary: The results press release gives no new production, spending or earnings outlook. It repeats a longer-term aim to add over $4bn in annual cash flow by 2030.

call.source: No call coverage found (call scheduled for 10 Nov 2026)

watch: Q4 production and spending outlook, which the release did not include.
How oil price moves and gas pipeline constraints affect Q4 cash flow.
